description: This file provides React hooks and utility functions for implementing progressive batch processing in React applications, allowing large tasks to be split into smaller chunks that yield control to the UI thread periodically to maintain responsiveness.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, supporting start and cancel operations, and progress reporting.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: React hook that manages the state and lifecycle of progressive batch processing, providing start and cancel functions and tracking progress.
